s.desc:
《雾锁王国》是一款单人/合作生存动作RPG，在这里，你的自由与创造力将被摆在第一位。竭尽全力战胜蚕食薪谷王国的腐化瘴气：探索手工打造的瑰丽世界，揭开隐藏的秘密并披荆斩棘开辟道路，在完全支持地形改造的世界中尽情建造。

崛起吧，火之子
从漫长沉睡中苏醒，如今你已经成为陨落王国最后的希望。利用颇具深度的技能树系统打造与众不同的英雄：重装坦克、致命游侠、毁灭天地的战斗法师，亦或是通过灵活组合来创造只属于你的游玩风格。

探索充满野性魅力的广袤世界
领略令人心旷神怡的景色并揭示来自陨落文明的秘密。穿越生机盎然的森林、烈日炙烤的沙丘、白雪皑皑的高山与被瘴气笼罩的遗迹。使用抓钩跨越深不见底的沟壑、从令人头晕目眩的高度一跃而下并尽情滑翔、或者潜入水下以探索各种意想不到的地点。

生存与成长
发掘大自然的馈赠——狩猎、耕作、垂钓并寻觅稀有材料。拯救深陷瘴气之中的幸存者，见证最初的孤独小屋逐渐发展成工匠与居民熙攘不休的热闹村落，并借此解锁一系列的全新配方与装备。只有懂得未雨绸缪与随机应变之人才能真正求得生存。

不拘一格的战斗
不断积累实力并打倒原本不可一世的强敌。挥舞大剑、施放毁灭性魔法、钻研独门绝技或者组合不同类型的技艺，基于技能的战斗与天赋系统方便上手但又富有深度。

真正自由的建造
在薪谷中留下你的痕迹，只有你想不到，没有你造不出来的。凭借自己的双手让一座座威严要塞拔地而起，或者是在悬崖峭壁上修建世外桃源，随心所欲改造地形并根据自己的喜好精心装饰每一个房间。基于体素的建造系统意味着你将拥有极致的自由，这个世界就是你的家园。

征服瘴气
反击的时刻终于到来。深入威胁万物生灵的致命浓雾。面对最凶残的生物、获取前所未有的稀有材料并一步步从瘴气的魔掌中拯救薪谷。

铸就你的传奇 - 单打独斗或结伴同行
独自踏上这段旅程，或者加入至多8名玩家的合作游戏。战斗、建造、耕种或探索：重建王国需要每一个人的力量。

探索永无止境的冒险
通关战役并不是你的故事的终点。深入由数以百万计玩打造的精美世界与地牢，或者通过我们的“冒险分享”功能与他人分享自己的创意。

Exploration lets you gather resources, which you use to upgrade your gear, allowing you to open up new paths and improve your base, which grows a little larger after each adventure. Without reinventing the survival game formula, Enshrouded stands out as the most memorable title in the genre for us, despite fierce competition. critic.quote: A greatest hits mix of the finest bits of design, storytelling and pure terror to have come out of the series in its 30-year history, Resident Evil Requiem confidently does the impossible with a dual-protagonist setup that successfully makes Grace and Leon's sections feel like two sides of the same coin. The same disgusting, freaky, ridiculous coin. This is the best that Resident Evil has ever bee

The next evolution of the Resident Evil series has officially arrived and it delivers on nearly every front. From the visceral, gory combat to the tense, compounding sense of dread that accompanies every darkened hallway, Requiem feels like a love letter to every Resident Evil fan. The dual-protagonist addition works to near perfection, with Grace thriving on tense, survival horror driven moments

Resident Evil Requiem masterfully blends the classic setting and systems of RE2 with the exhilarating action of RE4, striking a perfect balance that respects long-time fans while welcoming newcomers. Although it suffers from a slightly underwhelming narrative and somewhat sluggish running mechanics, the stunning visuals powered by the RE Engine easily overshadow these minor flaws. Ultimately, this
Requiem wonderfully combines everything I love about Resident Evil's recent remakes and new installments, shining as a new, explosive entry that honors the series' 30-year history.

For anyone who's started the series from Resident Evil 7 onwards, Resident Evil Requiem may easily be one of the best in the series. For everyone else, the bar is high to be considered one of the greats, but it definitely does a heck of a job jumping for it.

We'd love to talk about Requiem as a masterpiece, the best of the three most recent numbered titles in the series. Unfortunately, despite a first installment of the adventure capable of achieving excellent results, we can't do so, nor can we hide our bitter taste as longtime fans. critic.quote: Bloodborne takes the best of Dark Souls and builds the unrelenting gaming challenge on a prefect foundation - it will test your abilities to the max. The first true must-have exclusive for PS4 is here. [Issue#252]
A new masterpiece on PlayStation 4.

With aggression as its invitation, Bloodborne invokes a calculated shift in Souls parlance. Its aim isn't necessarily a course correction, but rather a Y-axis slant into an alternative series of objectives. Sacrificed are a few degrees of personal customization, only to be replaced by a renewed sense of distress and wonder. Bloodborne’s demanding novelty, even with its unrepentant focus, feels bui

Bloodborne is an incredible game; tight in its mechanics, logical in its systems, rewarding, intense, gloriously frustrating and exciting in equal measure. The PS4 has its first absolutely essential game. As if there was ever any doubt.
Bloodborne is some of the best work From Software's ever done, a remarkable achievement and a shrewd turn from its Souls lineage.

Give it a chance – not just a couple of hours, mind, but five or ten; enough to let its claws sink in nice and deep – and you’ll probably find Bloodborne an intoxicating dose of pure masochistic pleasure.

The classic from 2005 has been modernized in such a way that it is actually more fun than most Resident Evil games and many, if not all contemporary survival horror games.

This remake of Resident Evil 4 is an homage to a classic, very respectful with it (maybe a bit too much respectful). It´s a terrific action game, but we miss some of the braveness Capcom had for the Resident Evil 2 remake.

Resident Evil 4 Remake successfully modernizes one of the most significant sequels in the series. critic.quote: The stunning graphics, incredible survival horror combat and wonderfully eerie setting make picking up a copy of Resident Evil 2 a no-brainer.

Resident Evil 2 Remake is everything a remake should aspire to be. It captures the feel of the original almost perfectly while updating and improving almost everything. It has its flaws, but nothing detracts from the excellent experience. It's fun, spooky, and everything Resident Evil 2 was — but even better. Fans of the franchise and newcomers should enjoy themselves greatly. If you like killing
Resident Evil 2 plays its cards very well, and offers its benefits to a level of excellence that make this remake a title that's indispensable.

Resident Evil 2’s remake highlights just how great Capcom’s first sequel in the Resident Evil series ways, but does it in a way that makes it the most compelling entry in the series thus far. It’s smart changes merge with the classic design expertly, while its atmosphere is rich thanks to gorgeous lighting and incredible sound design. It’s a reminder of the past, but this remake would be a fine di

Aside from the disappointing 2nd Run scenarios, I feel confident in saying that this is the best Resident Evil game ever released. It brings back everything that fans loved from the PS1 classic, and presents it in a fresh, modern way that's both exciting and nostalgic in a modern age.
In spite of its progression carrying the weight of the years and its strongly cliche scenario, Resident Evil 2 remains an exciting game in its mode of thought, its inventiveness and its execution.

退休的财宝猎人内森·德雷克在他最后一次冒险的几年后，被迫重操旧业。当德雷克早已被认定身亡的哥哥山姆再次现身，寻求内森的帮忙以拯救其性命，同时提出一场德雷克不能抗拒的冒险，于是他再度听取命运的召唤，出发找寻埃弗瑞船长失落已久的海盗宝藏。

critic.quote: Both titles were exceptional in the respective years of release, and in the Legacy of Thieves Collection, both Uncharted 4, and The Lost Legacy are the best they’ve ever been.

The Uncharted: Legacy of Thieves Collection is every bit as good as the individual games were upon their original release. This remastered collection shows exactly why the Uncharted series was and is so highly regarded, even 6 and 5 years later, respectively.

Both games this remaster aims to upgrade haven’t really aged at all, at least gameplay-wise. They are still epic, still a bit silly, still beautiful and still charming thanks to their characters. Now everything is just a bit more stunning, sharper, smoother and overall more enjoyable owing to the amazing DualSense.

No doubt some will have expected more of a visual overhaul, but it's hard to find fault with Uncharted: Legacy of Thieves Collection. Both Uncharted 4: A Thief's End and The Lost Legacy still look stunning, and thanks to better frame rates and other PS5-centric features they are more immersive and fun to play than ever before. critic.quote: We Were Here Tomorrow have some of the smartest and thoughtfully designed puzzles the genre has to offer, set in a resplendent environment that’s a joy to explore, although they can be particularly challenging to solve. critic.quote: Superb zombie-slaying combat and enjoyable motorcycle gameplay are integrated perfectly with a well-paced story. But the game’s major highlights are the terrifying zombie hordes which are unlike anything seen in a videogame so far.

For better or for worse, Day Gone exceeds expectations. Bend Studio focuses heavily on the plot of its latest work, sometimes even at the expense of the gameplay, forced to adapt to the narrative needs of the survival game. Despite this, Days gone is still a very unique experience, thanks to its extremely recognizable personality shining through.

With jaw-dropping graphics, fantastic music, great gameplay, likeable characters - and terrifying hordes - it is hard to tell that Days Gone is Bend Studios first truly big-budget game. Even though the game is not as polished as the best first party games from Sony, it still might end up as one this year’s best single player experiences.
The game has weak shooting systems and some bad weapons, much like Red Dead Redemption II. But while the other games have been highly rated, Days Gone has had its legs cut out by the bugs.

Days Gone is a fine addition to the evergrowing list of first-party Sony exclusives. Does it have the shine and polish comparable to Naughty Dog's best works? No, but it delivers a dense and beautiful open world that proves that there's perhaps a little bit of elbow room left for zombies in gaming, even if we're not calling them that this time around.

Days Gone is a derivative but enjoyable action-adventure with a beautiful environment, using AI and physics to create exciting moments of procedural entertainment. 巴黎女巫烘焙师日常
小女巫露恩是这座城市中的萌新！每天的生活分为三个阶段：

白天：露恩驻守烘焙坊，施展小小的魔法帮顾客化解烦恼。

深夜：在温馨舒适的工作室中放松身心，提高魔法技能，装点烘焙小店。

随着日子一天天过去，游戏不断推进，你会获得更多的经验、资金和名气，邂逅更多的朋友，并治愈他们的心灵。

缤纷巴黎的快乐冒险！
完成一天辛苦的工作，你可以前往巴黎的各个行政区，遇见各位主要角色，参加多种活动，学习新技能，选购新的食谱书等等。
从蒙马特、林荫大道等名区街道，到只有本地人知晓的隐秘瑰宝，巴黎的无尽奇妙等你探索。每个区都有独一无二的角色、活动和店铺哦！

发现心中的情感与柔软
有时候，我们会将感情压抑到最深处，锁在最难找到的角落。而为了帮助他人，露恩需要深入思想与感情诞生的奇妙地方——“心之宫殿”，引导拟人化的感情回归心灵。

在心之宫殿中，露恩会了解到每个人最隐秘的烦恼与忧愁，然后找到所需的关键原料，烘焙出能治愈人心的面包！

s.desc:
故事发生在《瘟疫传说：安魂曲》十五年前，索菲亚年纪尚轻，心狠手辣，四处抢掠，奔走逃亡，同时下定决心查清自己身世的众多秘密。原创剧情与战斗融汇，神话与宿命交织，以新的方式展现《瘟疫传说》的宇宙。 

索菲亚一路来到米诺陶岛，与穷追不舍的军队周旋之余，还要走过凶险的小路，动脑破解谜题，直面决定生死的险恶考验。不过，真正的考验还在后面——隐于神话之中的那可怖生物，即将与她产生共鸣…… 

逐渐深入岛屿腹地，查明诅咒背后的真相。 

• 身后有众多敌人追击，意欲登岛夺回神秘宝藏，你必须面对环生险象，走到迷宫中央。依靠你的身手、计谋和反应，智取敌人，精进格挡技术，猛烈攻击，才能大难不死，活到最后。 
• 往返于索菲亚所处的中世纪与古代的米诺斯时代之间，往昔的回响将影响当下的战局。宿命与玛库拉的神秘影响令两个主人公的的故事交织，《瘟疫传说》宇宙的新篇章就此徐徐展开。 
• 根据笔记本守卫的知识，循着同伴的足迹，探索这个细节丰富的世界，揭晓其中的秘密，直面险恶的考验。运用的米诺斯圆球，解决精妙的谜题。破谜需要操控光线，而光正是代达罗斯编入岛屿核心的一股力量。 
• 传说能从岛上回来的人少之又少。暗影之中潜伏着极不安分的东西，总是紧随人后，似乎对你的一举一动了如指掌，岛屿深处就是它的猎场。每一步都有风险，每一次迟疑也有可能丧命。你不能原地不动，必须时刻寻找藏身之地，想方设法向前挺进。 

你能不能步步为营，挺过每一次考验？还是……像那些人一样，一去不复返？

critic.quote: A haunting, emotional story is paired with fantastic combat, exploration, and puzzle-solving. Resonance: A Plague Tale solidifies the franchise as one of the best franchises of the modern era and shouldn't be missed.

The next step in a clear path from Innocence, through Requiem, Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy confidently switches to a full on action-adventure in the vein of Uncharted. A good combat system, simple story-serving design choices and a great story, make this a joy and to play, even as the dread mounts and you descend into the heart of darkness towards scenes every bit and terrifying and memorable
A Plague Tale: Resonance boldly reinvents the series with a fresh setting, strong new protagonist, and engaging exploration. Despite minor flaws, it’s the refreshing new beginning the series needed.

As a prequel to Asobo Studio's pair of popular A Plague Tale games, Resonance takes the risk of not only introducing a new protagonist, but significantly switching up the franchise's enduring gameplay formula. Forgoing the stealth, survival, and relentless rat swarms the series is known for, Sophia's story is a swashbuckling one, packed with fast, action-focused combat and plenty of puzzles to sol

Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy could have been so much more. It could also have been so much less. It's a title that envelops you with its incredible atmosphere, flatters you with the quality of its cutscenes, enchants you with music reminiscent of Homeric myth, then after a few hours brings you back to reality with an almost too-stultifying structure. The team at Asobo Studio demonstrates its ma

A Plague Tale: Resonance trades stealth for swordplay as Sophia journeys to Crete to confront visions tied to the myth of the Minotaur. The story is gripping despite predictable turns, but shallow combat and repetitive light-based puzzles keep this prequel from matching the heights of its predecessors.

critic.quote: If you were left wanting in RE5 there's a good chance RE6 will satisfy you. There's a reason you're being fired at, there are plenty of tense moments and stress, the storytelling is superb, and "zombies" make a return.
A somewhat bumpy, uneven ride perhaps, but one that entertains far more than disappoints.

An accomplished shooter on the whole, and a fittingly thunderous send-off for current gen Resident Evil. The next instalment needs to tighten the focus, deciding which ideas are worth sticking with, but this could be the definitive videogame blockbuster - huge, colourful and surprising.

Where RE6 truly shines is in the game mechanics and ancillary modes. Mercs is back and better than ever. When married with all of the new mechanics (quick-shotting, rolling, aiming while laying down, and more), Mercs becomes a much more action oriented experience, which enhances the enjoyment of it tenfold.

At the end of the day, Resident Evil 6 is packed to the gills with features and absolutely looks the part, no one can deny that, but its lack of gameplay identity leaves it as empty and vacuous as the higher brain function of any one of its zombie inhabitants.
Apparently no lessons were learned from that game, as Resident Evil 6 is a textbook example of too many cooks spoiling the broth; a jack of all trades but a master of none.

Bold, colourful and entirely silly, Moving Out 2 is a must-play for couch co-op fans. A sequel to 2020’s Moving Out perhaps wasn’t needed, and this doesn’t exactly reinvent the wheel. Moving Out 2 is an accomplished sequel, building on what made the first game great and really honing in on its presentation and content offering. It's not a radical departure, and not all of its levels are designed equally, but overall this is another feather in SMG Studio's cap.

critic.quote: Berserk and the Band of the Hawk is the pinnacle of musou games, as far as I’m concerned. Omega Force and Koei Tecmo have experimented with the formula for years, and everything they’ve learned and perfected has led up to this game. Berserk Musou gives you the addictive, outrageous hack-and-slash combat musou games have had for ages. It gives you the unique characters and varied mission structures

Berserk: Band of the Hawk is a pretty good fit for the Dynasty Warriors formula. It keeps up the story's tension with a dramatic mission structure, and doesn't shy away from the source material's mature themes.
Berserk and the Band of the Hawk is, as Musou games go, undeniably enjoyable and satisfying.

Berserk and the Band of the Hawk could have been more than a simple re-issuing of the same Warriors formula that Omega Force has perfected over the years, but instead this is merely a re-telling of the Berserk story with a lot of emphasis on the Square and Triangle buttons.
Berserk and the Band of the Hawk is a nice game and the feeling of being part of Kentaro Miura's masterpiece is intense... for a few hours. Later it's just a little mess with a bit of Berserk.
While the game might be directed at Berserk fans first and foremost, it does not present anything new to those who played any of the Musou games, which is hardly appealing.

在一个完全可破坏的世界中策划并执行完美劫案。在《拆迁》中，一切都可以被破坏、移动，或被改造成一条捷径。慢慢来，发挥创造性的解决问题能力、蛮力，以及利用你周围的一切，开创出一条穿越关卡的高效路线。

奔跑、跳跃、驾驶、弹射。为了收集目标、躲避机器人，或偷走客户想要的一切，不惜一切代价——单人行动，或在多人模式中与好友并肩作战。不管你做什么……千万别被抓到。

完全可破坏的体素环境
逼真的物理效果、火焰、烟雾、水、碎片与载具
多人混战——最多12名玩家
极其丰富的工具与爆炸物
以剧情为驱动的游戏模式，包含40个任务，单人好玩，多人更是爽翻天。
沙盒模式提供无限资源与无限破坏，可单人游玩，也可与好友一同加入。
可通过免费 DLC 模组包获得逾百款由社区打造的模组。

剧情模式
为了拯救你的拆除公司，你接受了一份来路不明的委托，却被卷入一锅充满复仇、背叛与保险诈骗的浑水之中。很快，你就会发现自己在偷车、拆楼、炸保险箱、躲避动辄开火的机器人，以及做更多骇人听闻的勾当。

在环境中搜寻散落各处的隐藏贵重物品，升级你日益扩充的工具库。

模组制作

通过易于使用的模组浏览器，快速安装自定义地图、强力新工具、载具、游戏模式等更多内容。

多人游戏
最多可支持12名玩家一起进行线上联机游戏。为你和好友创建私人会话，或加入公共大厅。你可以游玩剧情，在沙盒模式中尽情玩乐，或体验由社区创作的模组。

沙盒
在沙盒模式中用无限资源和完全自由制造混乱。尽情实验、破坏、生成物体，并按你自己的规则来玩。

艺术破坏者
《拆迁》的免费迷你剧情扩展包，包含五个全新盗窃任务，背景设定在宁静的蒂拉格加德村。引入诸如送报枪和手持式风钻等全新工具。作为模组制作的《艺术破坏者》同时也是对《拆迁》强大模组系统的一次入门体验。

Teardown's greatest strength then lies in its underlying premise. The ability to jump into highly reactive maps with an assortment of fun tools to tear them apart remains as entertaining now as it was when I first started playing, and the chaotic nature of its physics are a consistent source of joy. I would absolutely recommend Resident Evil 3 and would not be surprised if a sizable portion of the fandom ends up preferring this remake.

Resident Evil 3 Remake is slightly disappointing after the stellar Resident Evil 2 Remake. It's still a good game, but its short length and lack of ambition mean that it will constantly be seen as the lesser sibling. The addition of the REsistance online mode should add some value for those who enjoy competitive online play, but the lack of single-player options is disappointing. All in all, it's
Despite being a title of undoubted breadth, this remake of Resident Evil 3 could have reached a certainly higher quality level.

critic.quote: It's a welcome change and breathes new life into the Onimusha franchise. [JPN Import]

Even with these few select caveats, Onimusha: Dawn of Dreams is a stellar addition to the series and a new beginning for Capcom's fourth largest franchise. One has to wonder with all the multiplayer RPG aspects, will there be an online Onimusha title on the horizon.
Great, fast gameplay, good story, nice cinematics, a wide variety of characters, and much more. The game is good at every level. [JPN Import]
Series heritage aside, this is a pleasingly lengthy adventure spread across two DVDs that's most definitely worth a look.
The progression of nearly every story element is handled with almost mathematical precision. The results are gaming-by-numbers, but the whole is a hell of a lot of fun.
Dawn of Dreams is a solid action game with a lot more play in it than its predecessors. More importantly, it's a title that shows that Capcom isn't afraid to mess with the formula.

Vehicles handling and physics are the worst parts of Dakar 18, but it's still an option for players looking for a refreshing driving experience.

To sum it all up, I recommend Dakar 18 for the hardcore racing fans that are up for a challenge, rather than someone trying to have some casual fun. critic.quote: Resident Evil: Village takes the ground work from the seventh part and mixes it together with the very best from the previous Resident Evil titles. It enchants and shocks us at the same time, to the point that we become completely addicted to it. A contemporary classic that sets a new standard, just as Resident Evil 4 once did.
Resident Evil Village shines brightly as one of this year’s early Game of the Year contenders. Whether you’re a fan of the series or a survival horror fan in general, be sure to pick it up.

Resident Evil Village is a wild, thrilling ride across seemingly every horror genre and idea that happened to pass through the mad minds at Capcom. Not every aspect of the game is perfect, but its highs are very high and solid core mechanics and excellent presentation hold the grisly patchwork together. You may survive Resident Evil Village, but your thoughts will linger there long after you’ve es

Resident Evil Village is truly the spiritual son of Resident Evil 4 and 7! This theme park of horror perfectly mixes horror and action and offers an extremely neat universe: the atmosphere is heavy, the bestiary generous, the casting is perfect and the puzzles bring a real cachet to one of the scariest Survival Horror I’ve been able to play in a long time. Unfortunately, the link with the series i
A superb game with excellent touches, great art and a confident execution. But its attempts to reintroduce classic design ideas from the saga are a bit lacking compared to the original ones.

Resident Evil Village expands the pared-back, first-person gameplay of Resident Evil 7 into a more ambitious and over-the-top survival horror experience. Greater variety and more mechanical depth prove that there’s a lot of potential left to explore in this new approach to the series, but some elements are a bit uneven, and you may find yourself missing the simplicity of the Baker ranch.

critic.quote: I was sold on Forever Ago from the trailer alone because I’m a sucker for these tear-jerking narrative experiences that happen to hit all the emotions. After being fully engrossed in Alfred's life, I know Third Shift has created something truly special. Forever Ago is an example of creative expression that the industry needs more of, and is definitely worth your time.

Forever Ago is an intimate and moving narrative experience that handles complex themes like aging and loss with rare delicacy. Although its measured pace requires some patience, Third Shift’s title possesses all the warmth needed to win over anyone looking for a profound and reflective story.
Forever Ago is a beautiful tale of loss, grief and growth, and Arthur's roadtrip reminds us all that you just can't plan life.

Forever Ago is a narrative experience that succeeds in how it handles its plot and prompts reflection on grief and the pain of loss. The gameplay could have explored the camera mechanics more, but the locations, memories, and people encountered along the journey offer moments of reflection and create a captivating experience.

Forever Ago is a celebration of life, a beautifully written road-trip on tragedy, love and healing. Despite its technical issues and lack of player agency, it's an example of how walking simulators create unique experiences.

Forever Ago is a moving narrative about love, loss, and rediscovery, carried by strong writing and a powerful soundtrack. While its minimal gameplay and rushed pacing hold it back, the emotional resonance makes it a memorable experience for the right audience.

critic.quote: This isn’t just a historically significant assemblage of games, it’s also an immensely fun one. Fans of the genre and those new to it should definitely consider giving it a download, particularly for the games that are appearing on home console for the first time.

The Capcom Beat ‘Em Up Bundle is another welcome feather in the cap that is their redemption arc that we’ve been seeing in 2018, and if you’re dying to knock heads with Mayor Haggar or rack up some coin with the crew of Battle Circuit, this is an excellent reminder of why Capcom did so much for this genre.

It’s a pity that this bundle does not include more prominent games, because the ones we get are probably completely obscure to many players. On the other hand though it’s a chance to travel to possibly unknown regions of the past and see how the genre evolved. Oh, and Armored Warriors is really cool. [12/2018, p.89]

It can be hard sometimes to make collections for retro games feel exciting, especially if those games have been released numerous times before. Capcom Beat ‘Em Up Bundle bucks that trend not only by having games that are still enjoyable to this day, but also by including two titles that are finally being released on consoles for the first time. A few issues mars the overall package, but not enough
While each title has its own appeal, brawlers are inherently repetitive by nature, so the focus on a single style of gameplay can be exhausting after a bit. [Issue #37 – January/February 2019, p. 20]
Irredeemably shallow but effortlessly entertaining, this unexpected tribute to a lost genre will make a beat ‘em-up fan of anyone.

critic.quote: This is a rare adventure game in which the journey is actually more of a reward than the destination.

Forget about the space battles and hours poured into crafting. Outer Wilds redefines what exploration means in a video game. Smart writing and ingenious game-design, it’s a vibrant call to follow your own curiosity.

As someone who loves adventure and puzzle games, Outer Wilds was a match made in heaven. It’s not action-packed, and there’s not crafting or deep survival mechanics like most space games have. Instead, it delivers an engaging mystery that isn’t spoon fed to you. It offers its own unique challenge that I highly recommend to anyone that loves video games or space.

Outer Wilds is a genuinely delightful experience with a lot of bright points. It somehow manages to take the idea of a game about repeatedly dying in terrible ways and makes it enjoyable, relaxing and enthusiastic. It won't be a game for everyone due to its self-guided nature and its focus on puzzling things out for yourself, but it's exactly the game it needs to be. If you long for the space trav
Outer Wilds is an absorbing experience, charming and unique. It may seem simple, but there’s much more than meets the eye. One of those special titles virtual explores will love.

It may not have the same scale as titles like No Man’s Sky, but Outer Wilds packs in more interesting lore, narrative, and puzzle-y mechanics in its handful of planets than most other titles out there. If you’re looking for a breath of fresh air and fancy venturing out into space for a laid back exploration and a damned good time, Outer Wilds should be your first port of call.

critic.quote: Arken Age is a VR action-adventure game about finding the creator of the world while using creative weapons to fight off cyborg-like enemies bent on anarchy. Roam an elaborate landscape and use your tools to intricately traverse the environments to stop an ever spreading corruption. Craft, swim, and battle your way to victory in this exceptional VR experience that you will never forget.

With incredible scenery, smooth gameplay, and a good campaign length, Arken Age is one of the best VR games ever made. Complete for action fans, it goes beyond its proposal by improving the physics-based combat system as we know it.

Arken Age delivers an incredibly immersive adventure through its exceptional tactile gameplay. Every aspect of the game is built around this core philosophy, quickly grounding you in its world. With a diverse arsenal and unparalleled freedom of traversal, it offers the kind of complete experience VR gamers have long been craving. While it may not prioritize storytelling, it remains an essential ti

Arken Age delivers clever VR-first gameplay design for a great sci-fi adventure. The intense motion makes this unsuitable for VR newcomers and the narrative isn't especially compelling, yet the vibrant presentation and rewarding combat makes this easier to overlook. Between combat's great integration of haptic feedback, strong enemy variety and satisfying kills, Arken Age is an easy recommendation

critic.quote: Knocking it out of the park once again, San Diego Studio continues to make MLB The Show 26 a premier sports sim.

MLB The Show 26 from developer San Diego Studio and publisher Sony Interactive Entertainment is a solid improvement from last year’s game, with more data inclusion, smoother career decision-making, and better backend gameplay refinements. While not a huge leap from the previous year, it’s still a good release with enough reason to consider it, especially if you’re a new player who doesn’t have las

MLB The Show 26 once again confirms the series’ solidity. It doesn’t revolutionize the formula, but it improves it in several key aspects, offering an extremely refined and content-rich sports experience. For baseball fans, it remains simply the most complete simulation available today.

Still, MLB The Show 26 comes down to playing ball, and in that sense, it still remains capable of draining away chunks of your day (or week). Few sports games have done as well in mastering the soul of its sport. The pacing, tension, and strategy of the game translate wonderfully, and it's still the best day at the gaming ballpark you can find.

If you played MLB The Show 25, you can probably skip MLB The Show 26, but if you are someone that didn't check out last year's version, the new game will likely provide more value. MLB The Show 26 is iterative, not essential, and while it delivers fantastic core gameplay and enough content to keep hardcore baseball fans busy for hours on end, the franchise could definitely benefit from a more sign

MLB The Show 26 retains the series reputation as a fun game of baseball. If you've never played a baseball game before, you won't be disappointed. If you have, it's hard to ignore the shortcomings. The visuals are dated and need an overhaul, which hopefully will come in the next generation of consoles. The hitting with the Big Zone Hitting and adjustable zone speed is some of the best in the histo

critic.quote: No game, film, book or otherwise has been more effectively in capturing what the experience of exploring the universe must be. Lonely, hostile and unforgiving, Hello Game’s effort works so hard to reject the convention on how games are made that it’s easy to understand why people expecting something more traditional might come away disappointed.

It brings a relaxing gameplay design that is geared more towards exploration, rather than sci-fi action. In addition to exploration, it has a healthy crafting system, an interesting monetary structure that adds extra motivation, and an endless amount of adventures and secrets to uncover along the way.
Hello Games' procedural dream is becoming a reality, but we'll probably need to wait months/years to see the process completed.

Hello Games achieved what they set out to do. They have crafted a massive galaxy of planets for players to explore. That feat is nothing short of extraordinary, and I think everyone who enjoys games should experience that. Whether you come out of it with a smile or a frown, it is entirely dependent on how much you are willing to put up with to explore a nearly endless galaxy.

No Man's Sky's journey across a massive procedural universe is compelling in how seamless it feels, the way that it allows you to explore at your own pace, and its questioning of the drive toward completionism found in most games. Unfortunately, it's saddled with a terrible interface and a crushing sense of repetition, both of which come to overshadow its more interesting qualities. As such, while

The universe is huge. It instills such a feeling of insignificance and it is incredibly fun to think of all the possibilities when arriving in a new place, but when it inevitably requires the patience to do the same things over and over, the wonder of exploration loses out on some important magic.

critic.quote: Shadow of the Tomb Raider is the best game in this trilogy and was well worth the wait. I've been trying to hold myself back with gushing about all the things so I don't spoil it for everyone, but seriously this game is a masterpiece. Yes, there are some things which bothered me while playing but overall the experience was magnificent and should not be missed.

Exciting from the title screen to the closing credits, Shadow of the Tomb Raider is a tremendous thrill ride. It’s the definitive final chapter for story threads we’ve been following since 2013’s game, but also leaves the door open for more adventures in the future. We’ve got our fingers crossed that this isn’t Lara’s last hurrah. It doesn’t matter where she travels. Lara is going to be involved i

Shadow of the Tomb Raider delivers a great new adventure. However, the closure of the trilogy does not stand its ground with enough courage in order to try and provide remarkable new elements, which in the end leaves us with a bittersweet feeling.

With Shadow of the Tomb Raider, we get one of the best episodes of the whole franchise. It doesn't intend to revolutionize the formula the reboot put in place in 2013, but it has a quite interesting story and a dashing setting, offers a well balanced experience, and has a huge amount of challenges that will surely please plenty of virtual explorers.
Lara's origin story ends in a lukewarm fashion. It lacks thrills and its early story potential is wasted. [Nov 2018, p.76]
Shallow story aside, Shadow of the Tomb Raider has the best tomb exploration in the series, and that’s what it’s all about.

critic.quote: The gorgeous graphics, the superb sound, the great (if sometimes twitchy) AI of your partner and the jaw-dropping gameplay take everything that was brilliant about Resident Evil 4 and ramp it up to the next level, making for one of the best gaming experiences ever!
Resident Evil 5 doesn’t revolutionize Resident Evil 4’s gameplay, but it does provide a solid and entertaining entry in the series.

The setting change works well, and the story will please series followers, with surprises and comebacks which will thrill Resident Evil fans. Resident Evil 5 offers a quality experience, despite some incongruities - all of them can be overlood -, which will engage us in front of the TV for hours, thanks to its gameplay and its high doses of action, tension and fun.

It’s not going to revolutionize videogames and is definitely not a huge step forward in the series, but it contains some of the coolest set pieces and most incredible boss fights I have ever seen in my entire life. And that makes me very happy.

It is a great game, one that is a faithful update to a game that only four years ago attained universal acclaim, but in that time, things have changed and, for better and for worse, Resident Evil 5 has only made baby steps when compared to the giant leaps that its predecessor made, and because of this, won’t be getting near that perfect 10. The issues with A.I and the controls will put off some of

Thanks to the game's stubborn loyalty to stop-and-shoot, the result is distinctive, but with suspect partner AI to contend with, this is a game that only truly comes into its own with a friend who's up for a challenge.

critic.quote: A cracking rogue-like shooter that builds on the solid foundation of the previous game, Neon Abyss 2 offers countless hours of frantic fun.

Neon Abyss 2 is a solid addition to today's indie roguelike scene. It manages to stand out thanks to its fun and frantic combat, exploration that encourages experimenting with different builds using randomly discovered items, and challenging enemy design. While its overall structure doesn't feel particularly innovative and its guidance can sometimes be unclear, it's still an experience well worth

It’s fun, easy to pick up and play, has a ton of progression systems to keep you hooked, and customization to make runs as easy or hard as you want. I would’ve loved more opportunities to create proper builds rather than having mostly incremental upgrades each run, which could have added an extra layer of complexity that the best-in-class games

For better or for worse, Neon Abyss 2 feels very much like more Neon Abyss. But some meaningful changes in progression and permanent upgrades, along with a whole new way to play, make this zany roguelike just as gloriously addictive as the first game ever was.

Neon Abyss 2 is a beautiful sequel, with bolder visuals, flashier weapons and more game-breaking strategies. Unfortunately, the difficulty drops fast once you find the right item combination. The flashy gameplay is fun, but finding a game-breaking strategy happens a bit too quickly. 完整版包含“俄苏革命”和“飞鹰行动”附加内容，玩家可以访问1920年以后架空世界中所有全新的冒险。

《钢铁收割》是一款即时战略（RTS）游戏，背景设定在1920年以后的架空世界，时间就在第一次世界大战结束之后。在游戏中，你可以控制巨大的柴油朋克机甲，体验史诗般的单人与合作战役，遭遇战中紧张刺激的战场迎合了多人游戏粉丝的需求。《钢铁收割》正是我们期待已久的经典即时战略游戏。

传统与科学技术进步的冲突日益激烈，而此时的欧洲尚未完全从世界大战的创伤中恢复过来。城市正在重建，而在农村，钢铁收割的时代已经开始了。农民们逐渐发现了战争机器的巨大残骸，它们曾在世界大战的战场上穿梭和战斗。

在混乱中出现了新的威胁，欧洲再度面临生死存亡关头。秘密势力正筹谋不惜一切破坏各国的稳定，试图再次点燃战火，并最终控制整个世界。

主要特色：

经典即时战略游戏巅峰之作
带领数十种不同类型的单位进行战斗，巧妙地利用掩体，炸毁整栋的建筑。认真思考，制定计划，灵活运用包括隐匿方法在内的各种战术。对了，还有机甲，各种各样的众多机甲任你指挥。

激烈的单人战役和引人入胜的剧情故事
体验史诗般的复杂故事，在四大战役中完成超过27个任务。与好友组队，在合作模式中并肩作战，通关所有战役。

紧张刺激的合作模式和张力十足的多人战斗
体验包括天梯赛、排位赛和联赛在内的多人竞技。从为数众多的遭遇战地图和挑战地图中选择自己喜欢的进行游戏，可选单人和合作模式。

飞艇单位
所有阵营都拥有新的飞艇单位，它们将飞上云霄，征服世界。这些早期的飞行机器具有多个不同的种类，包括反应敏捷的飞天机车和乌索尼亚英雄梅森上将的巨型战舰等等，它们可以穿越任何地形，化身从天而降的死神。最勇敢的人将担任空降兵，深入敌后执行危险任务。

critic.quote: The setting and the world structure in Iron Harvest are profound and perfectly accompanied by the imposing music - absolute goose bumps.

If the RTS is dead, then Iron Harvest is some pretty slick necromancy. A classic-style single-player campaign with a strong story complements the absolute satisfaction of big, stompy mechs. [Single Player Score = 80]

Iron Harvest is a good game. KING Art Games did a good job responding to the demand of the players who clearly enjoy these types of games, but with all the ideas they proposed, they could have done something really new. It has a lot of single player content and a good AI both in the campaign and in quick games.
Iron Harvest delivers some fun tactical gameplay, some gorgeous visuals, and some real disappointment.

While not quite hitting the heights of Company of Heroes or World in Conflict, Iron Harvest is one of the best RTS games to come out within the past few years, largely indebted to Jakub Rozalski's art and the lore already built upon by Scythe. s.desc:
统治奇幻的世界，万般皆由你作主，尽在《Age of Wonders 4》！在《Age of Wonders》标志性的4X战略回合制战斗中探索全新的魔法世界。以回合为单位扩展你的帝国，让你的派系不断发展，不断壮大

Triumph Studios屡获殊荣的战略系列已经进入了一个新的时代，这个系列游戏标志性的帝国建设、角色扮演与战争表现今日发展到了全新的水平。全新的事件系统与巨大的个性化帝国提供了无限的可重复游戏体验，每一次游玩都会为您不断写下的传奇故事增添新的篇章

强大的巫师之王已经重回世界，以神的身份统治着凡世之间。掌控魔典来进化你的人民，为史诗般的战斗做好准备，这将决定时代的未来！

创造你最狂野幻想的帝国

◾融合各种身体形态、行事特征与奥术力量来创作你的臣民。无论是食人成性的半身人还是神秘的月之精灵，甚至完全出于你最爱的幻想生物，一切尽在你的掌控
◾寻找强大的魔典来附魔你的军队、进化你的民众！让你的民众化为天使的子嗣或混沌的后裔，让物理上的变化来帮助他们直面敌人。以残酷的统治、狡猾的联盟或终极奥术知识来寻求荣耀，在世界的基本架构中打进你的烙印！

战略游戏与角色扮演的完美结合

◾每一个选择都会带来新的可能性与战术优势，多层次的深度战略让你可以随时尝试新战术，探索新力量
◾战术回合制战斗会让你的军队活力四射，在由你决定的战场上展示他们的力量。从与游荡怪物的遭遇战到双方均拥有数十个单位的大规模攻城战，更有士气系统与其它功能的帮助，每一场战斗都是一场全新的挑战
◾帝国、单位与环境的巨大多样性使得游戏具有了无限的可能。《Age of Wonders》现在拥有了前所未有的兼容性与开放性

在这个随机应变的巨大世界上留下你的印迹吧！

◾每场游戏都会让你探索全新的世界——或者创造自己的世界！从寒冰女王的霜原荒漠，到巨龙漫游的荒凉废墟，大量千变万化的地形地貌等待着你的探索
◾全新的事件系统为4X游戏提供了意想不到的故事叙述平台。无论是日益扩展的城邦，逡巡世间的军队，还是扭曲世界的魔法效果，周围世界的形象尽皆取决于你的决定
◾引导你的帝国实现辉煌的伟业，但故事不会以你的胜利或失败而结束！让你的领袖飞升至万神殿，从而进一步提升你的游戏体验。在此后的游戏中，你会以潜在的盟友或对手来遇到你所创造的角色，从而体验自己游戏的下一章！

critic.quote: You are not bound by fantasy stereotypes or archetypes, and can thus create often very bizarre combinations of races and their elements. It's a brilliantly done system, and one on which the authors will be able to build all their major or minor DLC for a few more years if sales are good. In an age of games as services, one couldn't ask for more from a solid strategy game. [Issue#327]
This is undoubtedly the best 4X game I’ve played in years, delivering top-notch exploration, combat, and diplomacy alongside a rewarding and dynamic customisation system.
Fans and newcomers alike will find an accessible, compelling real-time strategy experience in Age of Wonders 4.

Undoubtedly a very high-quality turn- based strategy. The remarkable combination of Heroes, Civilization (4X) and Total War brings a large number of options that you can use on different maps, it's just a shame that without a full-fledged story. At first it might seems to be complicated and a little messy, but you'll get the hang of it quickly.

Age of Wonders 4 brings the franchise back to its fantasy roots, offering a robust system that lets you go all-out with customization. Whether you’re out to role-play based on your selections or min-max to come up with game-breaking setups, you’re bound to spend numerous hours just trying out new strategies.

The keyword of Age of Wonders 4 is “choice” – the game provides a lot of it, expressed in all of its mechanics. Lending itself to near unlimited replayability, especially once the ambitious plans for expansions and new content are realized, Age of Wonders 4 is a natural evolution of the series’ classic formula and will have min-maxers and role-players alike suffer from a severe bout of one-more-tu

异食地牢生存SRPG！

critic.quote: Monster Menu: The Scavenger's Cookbook combines cooking and tactics combat to create a rather tasty RPG experience.

Monster Menu: The Scavenger’s Cookbook mixes survival, rogue-lite, and strategy RPG in an experimental product that’s just the sort of thing we come to expect from NIS. Unfortunately, the repetitive nature of the level design, the limited crafting systems, and the slow character evolution hinder the experience a little and keep it from shining as the unique, innovative rogue-lite it should have be

As a (mostly) classical roguelike, Monster Menu is a good time. It’s well-balanced in its efforts to be excruciatingly difficult. It also has an entertaining loot and character development system. Most importantly of all, the core cooking mechanic is engaging. It will force you to approach everything from exploration to battle in a different way than most roguelikes. But I really can’t help but wi

There are certain NIS America games that sometimes end up a bit forgotten compared to other titles, like Cladun or The Guided Fate Paradox, and I really hope Monster Menu: The Scavenger’s Cookbook isn’t one of them. There are some elements that feel like they aren’t quite there yet, like pacing or effect application, but what’s here feels really different and innovative. I enjoyed my time with it
A crossroad of different genres, Monster Menu is a curious take on S-JRPG by NIS, surely second to no one in this approach. Fun for some hours, not in the medium run.

Monster Menu: The Scavenger’s Cookbook is frustrating because I feel like there could be a good game in here. In fact, if NIS decided to put out a sequel, I might be inclined to check it out because they have made a number of excellent RPGs in the past. It just feels like they threw in so many systems, meters, and mechanics that they forgot to put in something to compel you to keep playing. There

critic.quote: This DLC is definitely a must buy for diehards but is something casual players really need to think about before making the plunge. Keep in mind though that Ultra Street Fighter IV is what this fighter should be and it has been perfected through hours of hard work to get it there.

Ultra Street Fighter 4 takes an already incredible, content-rich fighting game, and builds upon it in ways that fighting enthusiasts can get lost in and casual fans can enjoy. Every addition and refinement, both big and small, works.
Still enjoyable after all these years, the new content of Ultra helps revitalise Street Fighter IV and will no doubt keep it going for a good while to come. [Issue#113, p.81]
Ultra Street Fighter IV (again) changes our favorite fighting game for good, and the fans will love it... but if you're not an hardcore player of SFIV, it's not necessarily a must-have.

Regardless of the differing packages, Ultra Street Fighter IV is unequivocally the best of the lot, though the series is showing its wear after six years. Whether that means yet another SFIV installment will be arriving in the pipeline remains to be seen.

欢迎来到阳光普照、丧尸横行的亚利桑那州。

磨利砍刀，装填好霰弹枪，再叫上你的伙伴。荣获嘉奖、口碑爆棚的《Arizona Sunshine®》系列，如今带着劲爆的第三人称玩法和炎炎烈日下的合作激战模式，再度与世界各地的玩家见面。

《Arizona Sunshine®》延续了系列作品标志性的硬核战斗风格，同时承接了《Arizona Sunshine® VR 2》癫狂又意外感人的剧情故事。无论是剧情驱动的单人模式，还是混乱刺激的合作模式，玩家都能以全新方式在这令人心跳加速、血肉横飞而又充满黑色幽默的末日世界中艰难求生。每一场遭遇都可能瞬息万变、险象环生。

你将扮演主角桑尼——这位满嘴黑色幽默的幸存者已经独自在荒漠中待了太长时间，以至于他每天都在对着那些被他称作“弗雷德”的丧尸们自言自语。你将和你忠心耿耿、专啃丧尸的爱犬巴迪，一同踏上这场烈日灼灼、血腥四溅的亚利桑那州公路之旅。这将是一个诙谐而又疯狂的故事，关乎求生、孤独，以及一人一狗之间深厚的羁绊。

独自求生固然不错，但为什么不找人一同共渡这场末日浩劫呢？叫上好友，点份披萨，拿起控制器，即可开启混乱刺激的分屏联机；或者直接加入在线游戏，来一场双人丧尸猎杀狂欢。使用玩家最爱的经典武器和全新装备横扫尸潮——霰弹枪、砍刀、火焰喷射器等任你挑选。枪战一触即发，千钧一发的临场救援将成为家常便饭，局势永远出乎你的预料。

巴迪不只是你忠心耿耿，患难与共的四足伙伴，更是末日世界里最乖的“好狗狗”。它非常乐意与你并肩作战，一同将那些难缠的弗雷德们撕个粉碎。本作中，巴迪将首次在合作模式中成为可操控角色，为你解锁一种全新的末日体验。

《Arizona Sunshine®》现已全面重制为第三人称视角，带给你冲击力十足的动作场面和轻松易上手的合作玩法。酣畅淋漓的丧尸对战、夸张大胆的个性化设置、贯穿全程的黑色幽默，以及永不停歇的丧尸猎杀狂潮，等你来体验。

核心特色：
• 荣获嘉奖的丧尸作品焕新呈现，推出第三人称玩法
• 在危机四伏的求生之旅中，筑就意想不到的友谊
• 支持单人游玩，以及双人线上或分屏合作模式
• 巴迪首次在合作模式中成为可操控角色
• 手握霰弹枪、砍刀、火焰喷射器等各式武器，火力全开横扫海量尸潮
• 搞怪服饰与外观道具任你搭配，自由打造专属幸存者形象
• 探索烈日炙烤的末日世界，感受黑色幽默与混乱激战，并与无处不在的弗雷德们“打”成一片

《血污：夜之仪式》 是一款以探索为主的横向卷轴动作角色扮演游戏，游戏的故事背景设定在 18 世纪的英国，超自然力量召唤出了一座恶魔城堡，并释放出了充满强大魔力的水晶碎片。

玩家将扮演米利暗，被炼金术师诅咒导致身体结晶化的孤儿。为了拯救人类与自己，米利暗必须在战斗并穿越恶魔城堡的同时搜集、制作和解锁大量的武器、设备和战利品，以击败召唤者吉贝尔和在途中等候着的无数恶魔奴仆与 BOSS。

critic.quote: Bloodstained is absolutely, unapologetically a game made for Symphony of the Night's many fans, and it lives up to that legacy better than I ever could have hoped for.

Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night carries on the tradition of classic Igavania games in a masterful way. As a long-time fan of the genre, I personally can't wait for additional DLC as well as the inevitable sequel.
The wait was worth it. Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night is a whole new castle to crash full of unexpected monsters and mysteries in the vein of classic Castlevania.

It’s more than obvious that Bloodstained could be very well named “Castlevania” and nobody would mistake it as a true sequel to Symphony of the Night. Igarashi managed to completely capture and expand one of the more influential metroidvania titles no matter if sometimes it may look a tad familiar.
Although certainly rough around the edges, Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night is a solid adventure that will please Castlevania fans who have been longing for a new game to sink their teeth into.
Bloodstained is occasionally frustrating, refreshingly open, and as promised, wholly Castlevania.

critic.quote: One of the best things I played all year.
Rise of the Tomb Raider is an epic adventure, and it’s a story well told and well played.
Where the previous game is an over-the-top whirlwind, Rise of the Tomb Raider is better as a savored experience.

The last Lara Croft adventure comes with basic adjustments to its gameplay that make it an enjoyable and memorable experience. We loved the tombs, we loved the puzzles, we loved the exploration, we loved the world, we loved the combat. Even though not everything is completely perfect in Rise of The Tomb Raider, it’s a step in the right direction for the franchise.

An essential purchase, and although it's a case of simply being more Tomb Raider, lessons have been learned along the way to make this one of the most refined and enjoyable blockbuster rides available.

Lara truly shines in her newest game, with a sprawling world to explore and a great set of skills at her disposal. If only the world had been even bigger, with more hub areas and even more to do, this could easily have been a truly astonishing game.

《Detroit: Become Human™》是Quantic Dream开发的最新游戏，本作延续开发团队的传统（Fahrenheit/Heavy Rain™/ BEYOND: Two Souls™），为您带来憾人心弦、身历其境的故事体验。您将在一个由选择和后果所组成的壮烈的感性旅程中发现身为人的真正意义。

在2038年的底特律市，这座城市因发明并将仿生人带入日常生活中而欣欣向荣。 但是当仿生人开始表现得像是真的具有生命的时候，事情开始失控。 进入故事的三个关键角色卡菈、康纳和马库斯的角色，他们每个人都会从各自的独特观点，面对新的生活挑战。

critic.quote: Quantic Dream surpasses everything it has done before with Detroit: Become Human. A huge script allows for a thrilling story to have multiple layers that, at the same time, deal with topics such as slavery, the human condition or the concept of identity. A real masterpiece of the genre.
Despite a few storytelling shortfalls, Detroit: Become Human is stylish and slick from start to finish, and is easily Quantic Dream's best work to date.
Detroit: Become Human is a great game which points a flash light to our future. It's really interesting to experience such a great story with freedom to alter the fate of AIs.

Detroit: Become Human is a testament to how far the genre of interactive narrative storytelling has come and, at the same time, how much further it can go. While it might still suffer from some annoying QTE moments and a few narrative speedbumps, it delivers on promises that many other games in this genre make yet fail to keep, especially in how the choices you make can lead to very different expe

Though I wish its story had been handled with a softer touch, especially considering the subtlety that can be conveyed through its tech and performances, its well-written and acted central trio were vital enough to me that I found myself feeling genuine distress when they were in danger and a sense of victory when they triumphed. Most importantly, Detroit offers a multitude of transparent branchin

Detroit is well worth playing, but it struggles to strike the right balance between giving you freedom of choice and reminding you that it's all a game in the end. Cage and Quantic Dream are getting closer to nailing this style of game, but it's obvious that there's still room to grow.

critic.quote: There is so much fun in Wreckfest. A racing "deathmatch" which originated on the top demolition technology is full of crashes, tension, but also humor and DIY work.  [Issue#287]
Wreckfest maintains all its promises we expected in all these years of development: destruction, a very accurate physical model and a lot of fun.
Wreckfest is wild, a cornucopia of damage that shines in demolition, dampening the pain of a DNF with the pleasure of watching your car get destroyed in spectacular fashion.

Wreckfest is out of its early access, but there is still work to do, especially to give it a real "soul" in solo mode. It is far above all the competition in rendering physical damage on cars. It offers hours of discoveries and online racing.
If you liked FlatOut, you'll love Wreckfest. Drily presented, but wonderfully brutal full-contact racing with impressive physics.

Wreckfest is a solid product. It is fun, has a good amount of content, gives to the player a wide range of personalization and it is visually great. Because of that, even though it doesn’t offer something that we haven’t seen before, we recommend it for every player that likes the off-road and demolition genres.

critic.quote: Tropico 6 is a highly addictive city and government simulator that has realistic game mechanics with an easy to use build and management interface. A marvelous, challenging, enjoyable and non complicated experience.

Tropico 6 is not the hardest of hardcore simulation games, but for folks looking for something more casual, it’s a blast. It’s entertaining and addictive, and its minor interface flaws only stand out because the rest of the game is so polished and enjoyable.
I’d love it if Tropico 6 tried to be a bit more daring in its execution, but the game is still tried and true – in a good way.

Despite its flaws, Tropico 6 will definitely cause you to stay up later than you should. If you’re willing to forgive the lack of structure, you can spend hours and hours building on each of the included maps. There’s even a randomized map generator once you squeeze all the fun from the included content. In this way, Tropico 6 feels like an old school PC release, but it should still appeal to a wi
Entertaining strategy that lacks the humorous punch of its predecessors. A jack-of-all-trades, but master of none.

It certainly feels like the best Tropico game - but anyone who’s played a previous Tropico game might get bored at doing it all again (although the excellent missions help) and anyone who hasn’t might struggle to progress. In the end though, it’s still a worthy follow-up.

critic.quote: I question if it goes too far to say this is the best single-player experience I've ever had on my GCN. No boring moments like "Metroid Prime," no extreme tedium like "Wind Waker." It's like a roller coaster that never goes up, only down.

I have never had so much fun getting into a game as I have had with Resident Evil 4. Everything is just perfect about this game. The storyline, the graphics, the sound, the fear the game gives you. It is a A+ effort from Capcom.
The hit zone-based targeting system, for example, makes anything else in the genre seem obsolete and primitive. It's that sophisticated.

Resident Evil 4 displays such extreme mastery of the videogame medium that it deserves far more than any review could give it, which essentially makes the thousands of sycophantic words we've just battered out redundant.

A majestic work of gaming art, a true virtual masterpiece that simply must be played to be truly believed... It is apparent to me that this was a project that was loved from the moment it was dreamt up and that sense of caring simply shines through like a beacon in the darkness.

The combat gameplay is unrivaled, especially during some of the very creative boss battles. It's also the longest Resident Evil game yet, with 25 - 30 hours of gameplay on two discs along with a ton of unlockables that will make you want to do it all over again.

critic.quote: Tomb Raider Definitive Edition is a must have game on the PS4!

It's a bit disappointing that the remake of Tomb Raider could not
deliver any new content of value, but the graphics and next-gen effects
are eye candy that is more than welcome. This is not enough for the
already saved to buy Lara Croft's latest adventure again, but the game
is still a shining example of an entertaining action adventure that
should be experienced.

One of the best adventure games on console, with a fantastic blend of action and exploration. The Definitive Edition really is definitive, but isn't worth a repeat buy for those who've already experienced Lara's story.

It’s the same brilliant game that came out last year, all polished up and looking its finest. For returning adventurers, on the other hand, there’s so little in the way of new content that there’s not much point buying the new version unless you had an urge to replay it anyway.

Its thin characters and unconvincing narrative aside, the game maintains a sense of inertia, pounding action, and a balance between solid gunplay, distracting puzzles, and satisfying environmental traversal.

While all of these positives remain a huge plus, though, Tomb Raider still has plenty of flaws, the story being its biggest misstep. Incredibly obvious and packed full of cliches, you can't help but cringe at some of the dialogue as people speak to each other as if they were reciting a GCSE play. The Last of Us would laugh Tomb Raider out of the playground.

critic.quote: The Lego formula bring us one great family game, true to the Disney Pixar characters, full of details, and even better in local coop multiplayer. The Incredibles is a perfect game to share with your kids or younger siblings.

LEGO The Incredibles is a game you will definitely enjoy if you loved other LEGO games. It has some great humor and is a dream come true for all Pixar fans. Still, the game feels a bit uninspired with a lack of unique characters and the same bugs again.

TT’s Lego games slowly become a second iteration of Tecmo Koeis musou action: There is very little progress within the decade old mechanics - if at all. You like it or don’t. This is one of the less inspired stud-hunts of late, though.

LEGO The Incredibles 2 isn't the best platformer, or even the best LEGO game, but for younger gamers, big Pixar fans and those just wanting more from The Incredibles, it's a decent choice, by no means essential for anyone, but absolutely packed with a good few hours of fun with family members.

LEGO The Incredibles gives you everything you want from a LEGO game without breaking the mold. However, it doesn't address any of the franchise's problems and ultimately feels like the same old thing.
More competent than incredible, this middle-of-the-road tie-in replicates the films well enough but doesn’t mesh with the Lego formula as well as some other properties.

s.desc:
游戏简介
在《No More Room in Hell 2》中，你将作为应急救援者深入各处丧尸横行的阴森绝境，和队友汇合协作，完成关键生存任务，为人类存续搏出希望。危险时刻潜伏在侧，一旦撞上尸群，就有可能被病毒感染，救援者更会面临永久死亡惩罚。厮杀之路举步维艰，每一次胜利，都能让人类在末日边缘多一分喘息的余地。

高强度的 8 名玩家合作游玩模式
八位幸存者需要依靠智谋与临场反应，抵挡亡灵的轮番猛攻。通过近距离语音的方式与队友保持联络、争取会合，然后共同提升实力。绝境之中，沟通配合与战术规划是活下去的关键，物资极度紧缺，唯有互通共享才能支撑下去。你们必须用尽一切手段和装备牵制丧尸，平安逃离险境。你的每一个决定、每一次行动，都会改变尸群的行动规律，轻则引发毁灭性灾难，重则永久失去角色与全部养成进度。
 

两大特色游戏模式
情景模式下，救援者必须深入疫区腹地，一路搜集武器武装自己，攻克一系列生死攸关的核心任务，最终成功撤离并带回补给。游戏精心构建了 6 张细节拉满的宏大地图，全景式还原美国东北海岸在末日崩塌后的残破百态。玩家将穿梭于缅因州刘易斯顿、纽约百老汇等城市中心，转战于宾夕法尼亚工业郊区，甚至深入博利厄医院、政府地堡等隐秘设施。每张地图都拥有独立的昼夜环境与专属任务目标，为你带来截然不同的探索体验。在求生之路上，你将沿途发掘各类装备与物资，这不仅能大大增加存活几率，更能帮助你修复崩坏的基础设施，为人类文明的重启积蓄力量。

永久死亡和感染
每个任务都能让你的角色面临死亡风险——而且是永久性的。丧尸会感染你的身体、扭曲你的心智，让你陷入一场时间竞赛。你得尽快找到药物或基因治疗药剂，不然你就会沦为丧尸，变成你队友的敌人。搜刮到的物资能为小队提供助力，但唯有存活到最后，你的救援者才能领取所有奖励。每完成一次任务，你都能凭借过往的经验解锁增益技能、升级初始装备，让下一次的生存几率大大提升。你会不会冒着自己角色命悬一线的风险去拯救一名队友？越多的小队成员成功撤离，你们就能获得越多奖励，但是永久死亡的阴霾将一直笼罩。

动态感应尸潮
单个丧尸已然不容小觑，一旦成群结队，便会形成难以抗衡的致命威胁。不死怪物依旧保有完整感知，在死寂的黑暗环境中，任何一点声响都会引发连锁反应，引发大规模围攻。游戏内的丧尸多种多样，玩家必须全程保持警觉、步步抢先，否则便会遭遇惨烈死局，就连自己的救援者也会被同化，沦为丧尸大军的一员。

组建武器库
弹药很稀缺，丧尸很危险，玩家很脆弱。体验刺激的生存恐惧时，你需要给自己装备不同种类的武器——包括专业武器和临时制作的简易武器——以对抗和智取这些丧尸。在激烈的近身战斗中将撬棍捅进丧尸的头颅，或者朝着步步逼近的丧尸大军射出最后一颗霰弹枪子弹。游戏对玩家角色攻击丧尸时的恶心血腥场面做了无比细腻而逼真的动态呈现，仿佛一切就发生在你眼前，如此真实可感。细心规划你的遭遇战，运用那些有助于你智取而非强攻的工具（比如放置在敌人靠近时触发的炸弹陷阱或燃烧瓶），这样你才可能活得更久。为枪械加装瞄准镜、倍镜与消音器等配件，有效提升作战效率。救援者将在一次次任务中积累经验、精进技

critic.quote: No More Room in Hell 2 is a fun, fairly priced co-op survival game built above all to be enjoyed with friends taking down zombies together. If you have a group to play with and fancy a tense cooperative experience where survival genuinely matters, it's well worth the purchase. Its slow pace and focus on resource management set it apart from the instant thrills of other genre staples, but that's no
This is still tough, tense and genuinely terrifying. [Issue#428, p.114]

It’s remarkable to see the tide turning on No More Room In Hell 2, going from a botched early access launch that brought in a large number of negative Steam reviews to one of the best action coop experiences of 2026. Torn Banner Studios have really turned things around for this game, and I’m excited to see what the post-launch support will bring.

Though No More Room in Hell 2 clearly leans into decades of zombie history, it feels, most of all, like a great mash-up of two of my favorite zombie games: It has the dread-inducing, life-or-death stakes of State of Decay wrapped in a tight co-op experience reminiscent of Left 4 Dead. Though some subpar shooting mechanics keep it from being as enjoyable as either of those, that’s also a very high

No More Room in Hell 2's 1.0 update is a solid representation of what happens when a developer commits to delivering something special for that 'graduation' point in an early-access lifecycle. It truly embodies everything meant by the word 'upgrade'.

If you're playing No More Room In Hell 2 on PC and comfortable parked at a desk with a mouse, you're going to have a great time. But 1.0 is supposed to mean the training wheels are off, and on controller, they're very much still on.

critic.quote: They Are Billions' crucible of experimentation and failure molds players into rugged survivalists. The RTS-style resource management and tower defense test the ability to aptly devote time to the bare necessities that will fend off countless hordes of undead. Harder to master console controls may add an extra layer of tension but living another day remains the sweetest of rewards.
A supremely well constructed RTS that feels right at home on PS4, They Are Billions sets a new golden bar for other genre efforts to try and match.
If you don’t have a PC that’s up to standard or just want to suffer consecutive panic attacks from the comfort of your couch, They Are Billions is one of the best RTS games you will find on console.

They Are Billions does a lot of things great. The survival twist of a city-builder is unique, and lots of fun. Dealing with the huge waves is always as fun as it is stressful, including the huge final waves. Things that hold the game back are difficulty playing a computer game on console controls, and various UI and graphics issues as well as slowdown. This being said, it's a solid and unique RTS
They Are Billions is an interesting mashup of classic RTS, tower defense, and survival that successfully conjures up that “one more game” feel, assuming you can persevere through countless defeats.

This game is
best played up close – as you would with
a computer monitor – and not half a room
away on your sofa. While we don’t doubt that
with its tight strategy gameplay
and weekly challenges it’s a
compelling title on its native
platform, here it leaves much to
be desired. [Issue#166, p.92]

《Stage Tour》堪称音乐节奏游戏的全新进化。组建属于你的乐队，征服舞台，踏上巡演之路。伴随着音游史上规模最庞大的首发曲库之一，是时候走进聚光灯下，尽情释放你的音乐热情。

组建乐队

《Stage Tour》与吉普森（Gibson®）官方合作，玩家可解锁并收藏超过180把包括吉普森（Gibson®）、依披风（Epiphone®）与克莱默（Kramer®）在内的系列原厂吉他。汇聚全球最具标志性的乐器，每一次解锁，都将一段摇滚史加入你的收藏。超过50位独具特色的乐手等你集结，他们极具个性，更有各种皮肤可供解锁。自由搭配你的乐队阵容，打造独一无二的舞台风格。

征服舞台

玩家可以独自登台，也可以在本地或线上最多4名玩家联机组队，自由选择主音吉他、节奏吉他、鼓、演唱或手柄等方式表演游玩。在为各种类型玩家设计的、多种游戏模式与难度选项中，畅玩90首以上正版授权曲目，聆听横跨六十年的音乐风格。

● 快速游戏（Quickplay）—— 随时开启任意曲目，既可单飞，也可组团。

● 精准挑战（Judgements）—— 在专注准确度的模式中精通每一个音符，为追求完美表现的玩家而生。

● 练习模式（Practice）—— 针对高难度片段反复练习，掌握节奏，磨炼你的演奏技巧。

● 卡拉OK（Karaoke）—— 拿起麦克风，演唱你最爱的曲目。

踏上巡演

在全新的肉鸽风格单人冒险中开启巡演模式（Tour Mode），保证每次旅程都独一无二。
选择你的招牌音色，为巡演定下基调。赚取星星，在商店购买效果器踏板，为你的演出提供强力升级。一路从小型场馆走向座无虚席的巨型舞台，你的每一个选择都将影响巡演的走向。不断尝试新的策略，探索强力组合，在每一次全新的巡演中满足观众的期待。

玩出你的风格

从官方授权的克莱默（Kramer®）吉他控制器，到本作推出的鼓控制器和麦克风，再到普通游戏手柄与键盘，《Stage Tour》提供前所未有的多种演奏方式。
所有乐器均支持简单、普通、困难和专家四种难度。无论你是第一次登上舞台，还是久经沙场的节奏游戏老玩家，都能享受到真实、畅快且富有成就感的演奏体验。

舞台在你脚下

灯光已经亮起。
观众正在等待。
新时代就此开启。你还在等什么？

◆游戏内容

这是一款可让玩家重温 PATLABOR 众多经典场景的 3D 动作游戏。

玩家可从特车二课以及与其对立势力的不同视角，体验“Main Missions”和“Another Side Missions”。

操纵英格拉姆（Ingram）、狮鹫（Griffon）、零式（Type Zero）等经典 Labor，完成各项任务。

此外，“Simulator Mode”中登场超过 20 种 Labor，玩家可以挑战射击训练以及 Labor 之间的对战。

◆故事

Labor 是为工业用途而开发的机器人的总称。

随着其在建筑和土木工程领域的广泛普及，涉及 Labor 的犯罪也急剧增加。

为应对这一威胁，东京都警视厅在 Special Vehicles Section 2 下新设了 Patrol Labor Unit。

这就是俗称“PATLABOR”的诞生。

◆游戏特色1

游戏本篇以全语音形式再现 PATLABOR 的经典场景。

玩家可以欣赏 Special Vehicles Section 2 Division 2 的角色们登场的剧情部分。

◆游戏特色2

参与 PATLABOR 系列创作的创作者阵容对游戏开发进行了监修。

此外，主题曲“the Case Files”由川井宪次专为本作全新谱写。

・机械设计监修：出渊 裕
・剧本监修：伊藤 和典
・角色作画监修：高田 明美

・主题曲“the Case Files”
 作曲：川井 宪次

※ 发布预定日期、内容及规格可能会在未事先通知的情况下发生变更。

critic.quote: I wanted to enjoy PATLABOR the Case Files more than I did but its tedious and clumsy gameplay really makes it a tough game to recommend.

Overall, Patlabor: The Case Files plays like an awkward and suitably out-of-date mecha game that is overly faithful to its source material without really understanding what it is doing. It also comes across as a game done on the cheap and rushed to release. Even if you love the original anime, avoid this game. It’s genuinely terrible.

critic.quote: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes is easy to recommend to both casual and dedicated comics fans. It sticks pretty close to the time-tested formula for LEGO games, and I'm sure that most fans of the series wouldn't want it any other way.
Some technical shortcomings aside, this is a tremendously fun experience that will appeal to LEGO and comic book fans young and old alike.

The first time you see a little LEGO Bruce Banner burst into the Hulk you are sold on this game. With the huge array of characters and little easter eggs, it's great for Marvel-fans and even greater for the kids.
The series is in need of some lick and polish, but there's more than enough to put a smile of the faces of comic book fans.

This is exactly what you expect: Loads of super heroes and villains, millions of Lego studs to collect and an all-around entertaining experience without surprises. If Traveller’s Tales knows one thing, it is their Lego formula, to which they stick like glue.

LEGO Marvel Super Heroes is proof that both franchises have their place and appeal in the video games industry, but it’s also horribly exposing of the repetitive, tired mechanics employed to actually create a workable gameplay experience.

s.desc:
◆故事背景
曾因犯罪组织“乔卡 (Joecal)”与致死病毒“吉卡斯 (Zeekus)”等危机而屡次动荡的都市“新赛斯可 (Neo-Cisco)”。但每一次，都在少数勇敢战士的活跃下守住了正义。

而现在，为了对抗压倒性的巨恶，并揭开这一连串事件背后的“真正黑幕”，他们将再次挺身而出。

汇聚了新招式、新武器以及新伙伴的极上横版动作游戏《Rushing Beat》。更有冲击力倍增的热血双人合作故事模式，夺回城市的和平吧！

◆动作系统
通过简单操作的“自动连击”，即使是新手也能享受爽快感十足的动作体验。善用反击、追击及掉落武器等多样化招式，打造专属于你的独特连段。几乎所有的动作都能通过冲刺或跳跃进行“取消”。熟练运用取消技巧，向敌人发起更连贯的猛烈攻势吧！

投掷技可通过按键输入变换方向与类型。将目标敌人卷入其中，全力将他们击飞吧！若向画面深处投掷，还能破坏平时难以触及的场景物件，正是获得道具的好机会！

随着攻击命中或受到伤害，“愤怒条”将会持续上升。当能量条达到 MAX 时，将进入愤怒模式。除了攻防能力提升，还能施展终结技“Beat Rush”。用正义的怒火，彻底击溃邪恶！

◆游戏关卡
全篇共有 9 大关卡。从购物中心、贫民窟、地下铁到研究所，在各具特色的区域中击败阻碍前行的强敌，揭开故事背后的真相。

各场景还将触发“支线任务”。挑战多样化的动作技巧并攻略关卡机关吧！

◆登场角色
可操作角色将随着剧情推进逐渐增加，队伍最终将达到 6 人。

熟练掌握每位斗士各具特色的个性化招式吧！

此外，本作支持双人游玩。与伙伴一同，在通往《修罗 (Shura)》的道路上奋勇前行！

◆美食系统
进入同时也是关卡检查点的餐车“Tough enough”，即可将手中的食物道具进行组合。

使用 3 种食物制作出的“组合菜单”不仅能提升体力恢复量，甚至还会附带特殊效果。

无论是进攻还是进食，都推荐使用“Combo”！

m.title: RUSHING BEAT X: Return of Brawl Brothers

critic.quote: I really enjoyed Rushing Beat X: Return of Brawl Brothers. The core beat ‘em up combat is fantastic, and the goofy story gives the game a unique flavor. I never thought we would see another game in the series, and the devs obviously have great love for the source material. Unfortunately, Rushing Beat X: Return of Brawl Brothers is lacking in features, which puts it behind all the modern genre grea

Rushing Beat X: Return of Brawl Brothers isn't as rewarding to play as, say, Streets of Rage 4, but it's enjoyable nonetheless. Inconsistent visuals and a poorly localised story will be the biggest gripes with the game for some.

While the presentation is mixed and the game does ultimately run out of ideas, we actually do recommend this to beat-’em-up fans. There’s more depth to the combat than we anticipated, and there’s an air of weirdness to the whole endeavour that helps it to stand out.
An inventive revival that elevates a forgotten series with deep combat and personality, but uneven pacing, thin content, and inconsistent visuals hold Rushing Beat X back.

Regardless, Rushing Beat X makes up for some of its issues with old-school charm and technical gameplay. Those who are willing to look past the jank may find something to enjoy here. It’s just too bad it couldn’t have been better.

The underlying combo-heavy combat has enough of a crunch to give it all weight, even as the pacing and mechanics sometimes can’t live up to the potential. While the story mode is a fairly tight action game with a short run time, the various playable characters available provide enough extra edges to make replays fun. While lacking the pace of more successful modern beat ’em ups, Rushing Beat X has

critic.quote: There's a lot to love about Void Terrarium, with its touching story and unique approach to the mystery dungeon genre, even if does occasionally frustrate.

Unlike that other game about the mushroom-y apocalypse, Void Terrarium is an optimistic game despite its dour premise. It isn’t afraid to be funny even in a sad context, and it really clings onto a sense of hope.

It is exceedingly rare to have a video game bring up what essentially amounts to existentialism, and raise questions about a player's own life, all with very little dialogue. The emotional engagement for having the two primary characters not talk was stunning, and the inversion of real life pet toys was an interesting irony this played with very well. The setting, atmosphere, and story, were the h

Void Terrarium is a title that manages to be both beautiful and sad, somber and hopeful, and it keeps players coming back for more, despite its moments of frustration. Video games often task the player with saving the world or beating up groups of villains, yet Void Terrarium is about caring for a single person, and it manages to be far more engaging than most other titles in its genre.

Void Terrarium is tough, and it can be unforgiving with a lot of different systems to keep track of. But it's always a satisfying experience. It's not the greatest roguelike/Mystery Dungeon title I've played, but it might just have the most rewarding gameplay loop I've seen in the genre.

Overall, Void Terrarium is just an odd mix of ideas. Mystery Dungeon titles are popular, but this one sadly offers a weak example of mechanics in comparison to the broader genre. From there, being able to go full Tamagotchi with a girl in a glass bottle was intriguing and kept pushing me through the tedious and difficult dungeon crawling. s.desc:
《Warhammer Survivors》是一款快节奏轻肉鸽生存游戏，快来在游戏中化身弹幕地狱吧。扮演《战锤40,000》和《战锤：西格玛时代》宇宙中的角色，收集进化标志性武器，消灭层出不穷的敌人。

特色

- 暗黑世界中的狂热逆弹幕射击幸存者玩法。
- 超过40位来自《战锤40,000》和《战锤：西格玛时代》宇宙的标志性角色可供选择，甚至包括《Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun》的马鲁姆·凯多！
- 在残酷黑暗的第41个千年和凡世诸域中，畅玩多种模式及关卡。
- 存有75+款武器的军械库，如爆弹枪、阿斯塔特链锯剑和旋风斧，以及其貌不扬的努恩油等彩蛋。
- 直面最强大的怪物，包括臃肿得令人作呕的大不净者。面对极其强大的首领，就连吸血鬼幸存者类游戏的老玩家也会觉得难以战胜！
- 大量被动技能和强化道具，助你对抗骇人军团。
- 待你揭开的秘密和收集的收藏品！
- ……以及更多精彩内容！ 

横扫两大宇宙，释放毁灭之力
选择你的宇宙，成为帝国传奇或秩序勇士，在阿克夏广袤的灰烬平原，或是废弃太空残骸幽闭的走廊中，展开激烈对决。每一关都是全新的杀戮竞技场，拥有独特的敌军阵营……以及等待揭开的秘密。 

传奇英雄，任你选择
超过40位来自《战锤40,000》和《战锤：西格玛时代》宇宙的英雄任你选择。你可以扮演传奇政委塞巴斯蒂安·亚瑞克，雷霆铸造的雷铸神兵妮芙·黑爪，以及众多著名角色。每名角色都拥有独一无二的武器和初始数值，玩法各不相同。 

标志性武器，应有尽有

挥舞取自遥远未来和凡世诸域军械库的标志性武器。用链锯剑切除泰伦虫族的内脏，或用连发不止的爆弹枪粉碎敌人……要是都不管用的话，那就把它们浸入Warhammer Paints Nuln Oil里看看会怎么着吧。
混合搭配武器与强化道具，进化成毁灭性的新武器，创造清屏式弹幕，掀起刀剑风暴与魔法狂潮。 

无穷敌军，极度危险
歼灭那些步伐矫健、目光锐利的斯卡文鼠人和它们那被次元石腐化的可憎大军，或坚守阵地，抵抗贪婪的泰伦虫族和无数骇人的异形生物。
坚持得足够久，你就会遇到体型巨大、足以占满整个屏幕的首领，例如强大凶残的盖世骨·萨拉卡，以及大角鼠先知维兹克·斯考尔。他们才是最致命的威胁，你需要选择合适的勇士和装备才能制胜！ 

局外成长，持续变强
在无尽的战争中，死亡并不是勇士的终点。面对一波又一波来袭的敌人，你需要尽可能坚持下去，同时收集金币来不断强化自身，以面对未来回合中的劲敌。在战场上，你还能找到战锤漆罐，用以解锁更多角色形态和秘密。

为记念克洛斯贝尔篇第一章《英雄传说 零之轨迹》诞生十周年，
「特务支援课」的故事将于PlayStation®4上复苏！

《英雄传说 零之轨迹》以PS4™游戏之姿全新登场！

PS4™版除包含主线故事全程日文语音外，还支援60fps+ 高画质 & 高音质化，使作品表现力大幅提升！

此外，本作也搭载了「改」系列中备受好评的新功能「高速略过模式」，能以两倍速快转过场事件和原野移动，用四倍速快转战斗过程，实现比以往更畅快的游戏体验。

editions.name: 英雄传说 零之轨迹：改

s.desc:
在《RIDE 5》中，让你的引擎转起来，做好冲上赛道的准备吧。这将会是肾上腺素随时拉满的游戏体验，真实到仿佛真的在以超越极限的速度狂飙。

在这款终极摩托车游戏中，你将会找到最喜欢的摩托车，并不断发现新的惊喜！你可以在超过35条赛道上比赛，收集来自世界知名车厂的多达200辆摩托车，每个设计元素都旨在让你获得真正的摩托车驾驶体验。

这是一条漫漫长路
赢得比赛的要素不仅仅是速度 - 在耐力赛模式中，坚韧和策略也同样重要。时间不再是问题，你可以随心所欲，随时保存、退出，之后再重返游戏。一定要多多留意燃料存量和进站时机——稍不注意，它们就会成为令你头疼的恶梦！

从零开始的英雄之路
在新的生涯模式中，从你的车库出发，一级一级攀升，成为世界上最顶尖的赛车手。
与技术越来越精湛的对手比赛，他们将成为你和终点线之间的真正障碍。学会掌控不同的摩托车，处理各种赛道状况。
通往胜利的道路充满挑战，成功绝非易事，要接受哪一种挑战完全取决于你——挑战越难，奖励就越丰厚！

应对任何状况并取胜
不管你有多么优秀，有一个因素总是你无法控制的：天气。晴朗的蓝天可能随时变为倾盆暴雨，然后又拔云见日，翻腾的云彩将随着你冲过弯道，带给你不断变幻的景色。
你必须应对各种意料之外的状况，使用你的技巧来应对潮湿或干燥的赛道——改进的物理系统也提供了更加接近现实的体验！

试验。学习。前行。
不确定要走哪条行车线，或是不知道什么时候该踩刹车？使用新的行车辅助，在最需要的时候获取定制化的支援。学习如何更好地控制摩托车，掌握各种诀窍，充分发掘自身潜力，成为最好的摩托车手。

我的设计我做主
要分辨一位真正的摩托车迷，不单要看他们的车，也要看他们的车库——收集你喜欢的车型，并按照你的喜好来进行改装。与其他玩家分享你的设计，并展现你的风格！
不过别只把目光放在改装上。通过比赛创建器，你可以设计出无限多的场景，从单场比赛到完整的锦标赛，选择你的摩托车和赛道，然后像赛事总监一样，设置你自己的规则。

- 重新制作的环境 - 每个手工制作的洞穴都经过精心升级，增强了几何形状、新细节和更丰富的纹理，打造出更深、更有氛围的世界。

- HDR 和眼动追踪注视点渲染 – 全面的 HDR 支持可确保令人惊叹的对比度和清晰度，而眼动追踪注视点渲染可优化性能和图像质量，带来真正身临其境的体验。

critic.quote: A kid-friendly but uninspired take on the 2017 arcade game, better retro options exist for the TMNT crew.
Gameplay isn’t bad, nor buggy, but it is very formulaic.

Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Arcade: Wrath of the Mutants takes inspiration from one of the biggest classics of its genre, but fails to attempt to modernize the experience with its shallow gameplay and presentation. The outcome is a weak and repetitive game, even though it's a short one.

Wrath of the Mutants is an old-school arcade port that adds little new to the 'home' version of the game, which can still be completed in about an hour. It's mainly for TMNT collectors and younger fans of the newer turtles.

Inspired by Turtles in Time, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Arcade: Wrath of the Mutants certainly plays like a blast from the past. After Shredder's Revenge, you'll likely find its gameplay too basic, however, and it fails to impress in other ways, too.

Considering the resurgence of the Turtles franchise of late. It’s disappointing to see the brand reduced to this. If Fisher-price produced a game titled ‘My First Beat-em-up, this his would probably bit it. Stick to the pixel perfection of Shredders revenge for your Turtle Time.

critic.quote: Plants vs Zombies: Battle for Neighborville takes the foundation of the Garden Warfare series and expands upon it. No longer is the game just about competitive multiplayer, there’s now a wide variety of co-op activities for friends to play through. Whether you’re a fan of Garden Warfare, or new to the Plants vs Zombies series, there’s something for everyone in Battle for Neighborville.

With the many unique classes, the art style, humor and polish put forth by PopCap, Plants vs Zombies: Battle for Neighborville all culminates into a great time. You’ll lose hours blasting pesky plants or ridiculous zombies as your favorite characters. While it’s the third entry in the series, it still manages to stay fresh enough to welcome returning veterans and new players alike. If you’re into
Plants vs. Zombies: Battle for Neighborville embraces all of the charm and fun of its predecessors, but manages to up the ante with a lot of new and updated features.

Plants vs. Zombies Battle for Neighborville is a beautiful title. We have fun online with different modes of play. Teamplay is important but playing alone s not be the key to success. A time of adaptation is required to master the game and its gameplay. There are a lot of things to do in the game and the title takes on a more significant scale when played with friends. A good surprise in short.

Its PvE campaign may be a bit of a wash despite the Looney tunes approach, but if you’re looking for some addictive multiplayer action that hasn’t changed too much between instalments, Plants vs Zombies: Battle for Neighborville is still a chaotic start to the day that is packed full of vitamin C for crazy.

Online shooters don't get much more charming than Plants vs. Zombies: Battle for Neighborville. So, if you want a simple game to wind down with for a few hours then you won't regret giving it a try but just keep its downsides in mind before taking the plunge.

critic.quote: The transition to standard screens has done nothing to limit just how pretty this world is. Moss is gorgeous and really nails the sense of scope and scale we feel as an outsider looking down into a tiny world. I was just as hooked playing through this collection as I was when they released in VR. I sincerely hope that Moss finds its audience with this release. The world of Moss is rife with potent

Moss: The Forgotten Relic proves that the journey of Quill and the Reader never relied solely on the novelty of virtual reality, but rather on the strength of its narrative, the care put into puzzle design, and the genuine bond forged between protagonist and player. The package serves both as an entry point for those who have never experienced the series and as a heartwarming reunion for those who

Those without a VR headset can now be captivated by the adventures of the little mouse Quill in Moss: The Forgotten Relic, a pair of games that form a single epic. While the immersive quality of virtual reality is inevitably lost, the exuberant visual presentation and the fairy tale told by an excellent narrator captivate and give strength to a campaign that, although it has a somewhat clunky plat

Even if Moss: The Forgotten Relic loses a little bit of the personal magic that it's become known for with the removal of VR, Quill’s charming adventure absolutely manages to stand on its own two paws as a slightly more traditional puzzle platformer. More than anything, I’m grateful that anyone who couldn’t handle Moss in VR finally has a chance to try out a truly special game.

Moss’s world is stunning, its fairy tale nature is incredibly charming, and aside from a couple of minor issues with the camera (and one weird bug that briefly stalled my progress) this is a very smooth remake that doesn’t feel compromised by breaking free of its VR-exclusive origins. It may be simple, but its combat and puzzles are satisfying and amusing. But for me, Moss’s appeal comes back to Q

A slightly-less-magical version of Moss and its sequel might be a hard sell for those who've already experienced the incredible VR iterations, but both games have made the transition for "flat" play quite admirably. If you're yet to play them, or you're aching for a return to Quill's adventures, there's now a great option for doing so without strapping a TV to your head.

Yomawari: Lost in the Dark is a new game in the franchise five years after its last, delivering familiar gameplay and setting for fans of the series, but losing the opportunity to reinvent itself and target a wider public.

The presentation and the fear factor of Yomawari: Lost in the Dark leave a great first impression. The beautifully crafted visuals and moment-to-moment potential horror you face makes it an unnerving experience that’s hard to shake. However, the more you play, the less you’re rewarded with actual reasoning from the story. It’s a gut punch to persevere in the final act. This may be appealing to fan

Yomawari: Lost in the Dark is a decent horror title that never quite allows itself to excel in any particular area. Japanese horror fans will enjoy the variety of enemies and the scares, but outside of the cleanly drawn visuals and a decent story, it can’t escape the demon of its own design – a short runtime that just feels too long due to its repetitive gameplay and late-revealing secrets.

On top of that, we get even more excellent music from Chris Christodoulou. It cements Risk of Rain 2 as one of the best roguelikes of all time, and certainly one of the best co-op roguelikes too. There are a couple of th

Risk of Rain 2 is a must have. A love letter to the genre, a fun and engaging experience with tons of content, personality, and secrets. Version 1.0 adds a great final boss on top of the many enemies, items, challenges, maps and features included in the same patch and the previous ones.

s.desc:
天堂并不完全如你所愿：这里到处都是丧尸！幸运的是你可控制它们。捕捉丧尸，教它们耕种或战斗。它们会帮助你建设并保卫营地，而你要去探索世界，寻找……新的天堂。

欢迎来到ParadiZe！ 

你想拥有自己的丧尸伙伴吗？想拥有一个忠实的朋友，它保护你不被其他丧尸伤害，陪伴你完成所有的冒险？在ParadiZe，我们把这变成了现实！在这里，所有脏活累活都交给丧尸来干。 
在美丽的ParadiZe国，天才的幸存者们正在测试一种技术，这种技术可以用来控制肆虐全球的丧尸。一旦被控制，丧尸就变成了宝贵的盟友，尽管它们并不十分聪明，有时还很不稳定。 
ParadiZe并不都是美好的，但如果你足够聪明灵巧，也许就能生存下来……

充满惊喜的目的地

探索ParadiZe，结识个性鲜明的非凡人物。奇特的动植物会处处带来惊喜。可以选择独自上路或与Zombot伙伴一起，踏上雪地或沙漠的冒险之旅。请放心地清除任何试图干扰你与我们在一起的害虫。 
想去野外探险，还是想在营地里闲逛？根据自己的喜好来选择吧！ 
不过，我们建议不要与当地人走得太近：他们可能有些……好斗。
 

甜蜜家园 

来到这里后不久，你就必须建造自己的营地，这是个舒适的小窝，可以进行逐步升级。舒适度固然重要，但也别忘了架设防御！添加多个陷阱和防御工事用以击退丧尸，因为丧尸有个坏习惯，就是永远不会放过你。 
维护营地需要付出努力，但如果你不喜欢这些琐碎的工作，也不用担心：正如我们之前所说，这里的脏活累活都是丧尸干的。 
 

越多越快乐……

你可以在这里当个独行侠，也可以与其他人往来。
你最多可邀请三位朋友，让他们和你一起享受这难忘的体验。
ParadiZe会张开双臂欢迎所有人！

怎么样？还等什么？

critic.quote: ParadiZe doesn't take itself too seriously and takes the zombie theme lightly. It's one of those games that offers a mix of genres and if you don't accept them as a whole, you simply won't fully appreciate the game. Either take it all together and have fun, or leave it alone.
I haven't had this much fun in a co-op game since It Takes Two.
Not bad, not great: Welcome to ParadiZe is a fun pastime that made me want to play more Diablo IV.
Welcome to ParadiZe has a great sense of humour and super satisfying combat and crafting systems that elevate it above the surface jank.

Welcome to ParadiZe has a great core concept that is just shy of fully capitalizing on. I think it could have been a serious winner if the game had leaned more heavily into its base-building and crafting identity. As it stands, it is more of an okay ARPG title that, while definitely full of some interesting mechanics, isn’t the most exciting one on the market.
